item.title: Al Jazeera reports multiple explosions across Qatari capital Doha
item.description: Al Jazeera reports multiple explosions across Qatari capital Doha At least 11 explosions were heard on Sunday across the Qatari capital Doha, Al Jazeera reported, quoting residents of the city. On Saturday, Qatar’s Interior Ministry said falling missile fragments injured eight people, one of them seriously, following Iranian strikes on the country. “Eight people were injured by falling missile fragments, one of them seriously,” an official said.

item.title: Iran announces attacks on Israel, 27 US bases in Middle East
item.description: Iran announces attacks on Israel, 27 US bases in Middle East The IRGC on Sunday said that it is carrying out a sixth wave of attacks in retaliation for the US and Israeli bombardment of Iran, state media reported. The report said that the IRGC has launched “extensive missile and drone” attacks on Israel and US military bases in the region. item.title: Video: Crowds mourn Khamenei after state confirms killing
item.description: Video: Crowds mourn Khamenei after state confirms killing Thousands of Iranians gathered in cities across the country to mourn the killing of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, following official confirmation by state media. Large crowds filled streets in Tehran and other major cities, with mourners waving flags, holding portraits and chanting slogans. item.title: Trump warns Iran against retaliation, threatens unprecedented force
item.description: Trump warns Iran against retaliation, threatens unprecedented force Trump, on his Truth Social platform, warned Iran against retaliating, saying the United States would respond with unprecedented force if it did. “Iran just stated that they are going to hit very hard today,” he wrote. “They better not do that … because if they do, we will hit them with a force that has never been seen before.”

item.title: US issues warning as missiles and drones reported in Jordan airspace
item.description: US issues warning as missiles and drones reported in Jordan airspace The US embassy in Jordan on Sunday issued a security alert, urging people to take shelter. “Reports indicate missiles, drones, or rockets are in Jordanian airspace. Seek overhead cover and shelter in place immediately,” the alert said. “Remain indoors and pay attention to local announcements and alerts.”

item.title: Video: Protesters gather outside US Embassy in Baghdad
item.description: Video: Protesters gather outside US Embassy in Baghdad Protesters gathered outside the US Embassy in Baghdad amid a surge in regional tensions, sparked by anger over recent US and Israeli attacks on Iran, alongside the assassination of Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei. Demonstrators accuse Washington of fuelling instability in the region and have called for an end to foreign military involvement in the region. item.title: Second wave of blasts reported in Dubai, Doha and Manama
item.description: Second wave of blasts reported in Dubai, Doha and Manama A second wave of explosions was heard in Dubai on Sunday morning, as Iran carried out retaliatory attacks on the Gulf following US and Israeli strikes that killed the supreme leader, news agency AFP reported. Thick black smoke was also seen over Doha after several loud explosions were heard across the Qatari capital, the report said. Earlier blasts were heard in Dubai, Doha and the Bahraini capital Manama.

item.title: Israeli military tells residents not to share locations hit by Iran
item.description: Israeli military tells residents not to share locations hit by Iran The Israeli military on Sunday said residents must refrain from sharing the locations of areas hit by Iranian bombardment. The military in a post on X said that residents should stay in bunkers unless they are told to exit. “If no alert was received, stay in proximity to the protected space,” the statement reads.

item.title: Pakistan: Protestors storm US Consulate in Karachi after Khamenei assassination
item.description: Pakistan: Protestors storm US Consulate in Karachi after Khamenei assassination Protesters on Sunday stormed the US Consulate in Pakistan's Karachi amid a surge in tensions, sparked by anger over recent US and Israeli attacks on Iran, alongside the assassination of Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei. Video footage showed security forces opening fire on the protestors as angry demonstrators set fire to the guardhouse.
